newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers rise as buyers rush for supplies.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers rise as buyers rush for supplies.

text.p: Singapore bunkers on Friday soared as tensions in the Gulf sent shipowners scrambling for supplies but offers were scarce, traders said.
Bids for 380 cst leaped by $5.50 to be quoted at $123, up from $117-$118 per tonne on Thursday. Bunker 180 cst was indicated at $128, also up from Thursday's $123-$124.
Shipowners were covering requirements amid fears that prices would rise further as the Gulf tensions heightens. But sellers were unwilling to offer barrels as they expected prices to edge higher.
MDO was also quoted higher at $209-$210, up from $208-$212.
